text:
Maria (partnerships): Heads-up — launching the cloud marketplace onboarding kickoff for the publisher account. Need quick alignment on AMI/image naming, regional SKUs, and trial entitlement behavior.
Benji (solutions): Great. Are we doing a single image per region or per-arch + region?
Nora (eng-cloud): Per-arch + region. We need x86_64 and arm64 AMIs for AWS, and separate GCE images for us-central1, europe-west1.
Maria (partnerships): ok. Also need the vendor display name, short blurb, and 3 screenshots for storefront — marketing already has hero and 2 screenshots ready.
Oliver (legal): Quick legal note — for Azure private offers we must include the EULA URL and link to the Data Processing Addendum. Who's owning EULA hosting?
Benji (solutions): Can we host a static EULA on our docs site and point the marketplace to that URL?
Oliver (legal): Yes, but we need versioned URLs and a signer name. Benji, can you confirm we have versioning?
Benji (solutions): yep, docs.redwood.ai/legal/eula/v1.0 and v1.1 already created. I'll add the signer metadata.
Nora (eng-cloud): On the infra side: listing metadata needs an IAM role for publisher automation (publish-bot-role). Suggest: publisher-listing@redwood-inference. We'll give it minimal perms: image read, billing metadata, and listing publish.
Maria (partnerships): @Nora please add the exact role ARN and a sample Terraform snippet we can hand to partners.
Nora (eng-cloud): dropping snippet now:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "publisher_list_role" {
  name = "redwood-publisher-listing"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.trust.json
}
```
Maria (partnerships): perfect. Benji — for trials: do we enable a 14-day entitle trial SKU or a meter-based free tier?
Benji (solutions): For marketplaces we recommend a 14-day trial SKU mapped to a trial entitlement so we can track activations. Metered being plan B for enterprise customers.
Oliver (legal): Make sure trial terms include cancellation and data retention clauses. I'll drop a short paragraph to append to the EULA.
DevOps-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: publish-staging-images -> 1749993055 by CI.
Maria (partnerships): timelines: staging listing by Wed, legal sign-off Thu, public in 2 weeks. Can folks call out blockers?
Nora (eng-cloud): blocker — we need QA AMI build parity script to ensure feature flags match. I'll add that to the repo and ping QA. ETA Tue EOD.
Benji (solutions): blocker for me — logo assets need smaller favicon size (16x16). Marketing to deliver today.
Oliver (legal): blocker — contract redlines from partner procurement might require a 30-day payment term for marketplace billing. Need escalation plan if vendor pushes it.
Maria (partnerships): action items: 1) @Nora: provide role ARN + terraform in PR (#312), 2) @Benji: confirm screenshots + favicon, 3) @Oliver: append trial clause to EULA and confirm URL, 4) Partnerships will assemble listing manifest and IAM contact sheet.
Benji (solutions): noted. I'll update the checklist and add estimated sizes.
Nora (eng-cloud): added PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/cloud-images/pull/78
Maria (partnerships): Thanks — will schedule a short vendor call tomorrow 10am PST to walk publisher through setup and get final creds.
Benji (solutions): +1 for the call. I'll prep the sharing deck.
Oliver (legal): I'll be on the call for the EULA Q&A.
Maria (partnerships): wrap: uploading the initial manifest to the shared drive now (`/partnerships/marketplace/onboards/1749993000-manifest.xlsx`). Will ping when ready. :party-parrot:
